name: query_alphafold
description: Get AlphaFold protein structure prediction for a UniProt accession ID
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_alphafold; result = query_alphafold('P04637')

parameters.uniprot_id: str — UniProt accession ID (e.g. 'P04637' for TP53)

returns: dict with keys: uniprot_id, structure_url, pdb_url, plddt_score, model_created_date, source
